package rules

import "errors"

var ErrRule = errors.New("invalid or stale game command")

type Command struct {
	Seq      uint64
	Revision uint64
	Kind     string
	Choice   int
}
type Result struct {
	Revision uint64
	Reward   int
}
type Receipt struct {
	Command Command
	Result  Result
}

// 状态整体放在生成 DAO，局内缓存不持有另一个可变副本；失败由正式 DAO undo 回滚。
type State struct {
	Members  []int64
	Revision uint64
	Last     map[int64]Receipt
	Stage    int
	Votes    [2]int
	Cleared  bool
	Claimed  [2]bool
	Seed     uint64
}

func New(members []int64, now int64) (State, error) {
	if len(members) != 2 || members[0] <= 0 || members[1] <= 0 || members[0] == members[1] || now <= 0 {
		return State{}, ErrRule
	}
	return State{Members: append([]int64(nil), members...), Last: make(map[int64]Receipt), Votes: [2]int{-1, -1}, Seed: 12345}, nil
}
func (s *State) Apply(actor int64, cmd Command, now int64) (Result, error) {
	if len(s.Members) != 2 || s.Last == nil {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	index := -1
	for i, id := range s.Members {
		if id == actor {
			index = i
		}
	}
	if index < 0 || cmd.Seq == 0 {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	previous := s.Last[actor]
	if cmd.Seq == previous.Command.Seq {
		if cmd != previous.Command {
			return Result{}, ErrRule
		}
		return previous.Result, nil
	}
	if cmd.Seq != previous.Command.Seq+1 || cmd.Revision != s.Revision {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	reward, err := s.execute(index, cmd, now)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	s.Revision++
	result := Result{Revision: s.Revision, Reward: reward}
	s.Last[actor] = Receipt{Command: cmd, Result: result}
	return result, nil
}

// 本例是离散房间闯关，不是动作模拟。路径随机数只由持久种子与阶段确定，重连不重抽。
func (s *State) execute(index int, cmd Command, now int64) (int, error) {
	switch cmd.Kind {
	case "vote":
		if s.Cleared || cmd.Choice < 0 || cmd.Choice > 1 || s.Votes[index] != -1 {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Votes[index] = cmd.Choice
		if s.Votes[0] >= 0 && s.Votes[1] >= 0 {
			choice := s.Votes[0]
			if s.Votes[0] != s.Votes[1] {
				choice = int((s.Seed + uint64(s.Stage)) % 2)
			}
			s.Seed = s.Seed*6364136223846793005 + uint64(choice) + 1
			s.Stage++
			s.Votes = [2]int{-1, -1}
			s.Cleared = s.Stage == 3
		}
		return 0, nil
	case "claim":
		if !s.Cleared || s.Claimed[index] {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Claimed[index] = true
		return 10, nil
	default:
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
}

// View 不返回其他玩家的余额、命令回执或服务端随机种子。
type View struct {
	Revision uint64
	NextSeq  uint64
	Stage    int
	Cleared  bool
	Claimed  bool
	Coins    int64
}
